sloka: आह्वयन्त इव अन्योन्यम् नगाः षट्पद नादिताः ।कुसुमोत्तंस विटपाः शोभन्ते बहु लक्ष्मण ॥४-१-९२॥
transliteration: āhvayanta iva anyonyam nagāḥ ṣaṭpada nāditāḥ ।kusumottaṁsa viṭapāḥ śobhante bahu lakṣmaṇa ॥4-1-92॥

translations.english: 'The trees, crowned with flowers filled with humming bees, look splendid. It appears they are calling one another, O Lakshmana
